Find a verified teacher for any subject, try a free demo, and start learning — with your payment protected until the session is actually done. problem.heading:
Pakistan's tuition system runs on trust.
Right now, nothing protects it.
problem.body: Over 25 million Pakistani children are out of school — and the tuition system meant to fill that gap is almost entirely informal: Facebook groups, paper ads on walls, a stranger's WhatsApp number passed around. No verification. No safety net for your money. No accountability when it goes wrong.

cards.text: Appearing in his FSc Pre-Medical exams this year. His local academy charges Rs. 4,000/month — money his family can't spare. A "tutor" he found in a Facebook group took his father's advance payment and never came back.

Tops her class in Python and Web Development. She's already tutoring two juniors for free, purely because she's good at explaining things — but has no safe way to list herself, get paid properly, or prove her track record.
Ali needs exactly what Fatima can teach, and they're minutes apart. But nothing connects them safely — so Ali keeps struggling, and Fatima keeps teaching for free.

faqs.a: A safe way for students and teachers to find each other. Students post what they want to learn, teachers can send proposals, and paid sessions happen inside the app over video — with your money held safely until the session is actually done.

faqs.q: Is the Verified Badge really free?
faqs.a: Yes — completely free for the first two teachers per subject. That's a Rs. 1,999 value: CNIC verification, qualification review, and a short interview, at no cost, valid for one year. We make money later through optional profile boosts — not by charging you to get verified.

faqs.q: What happens after I join the waitlist?
faqs.a: You'll get an email the moment your subject is ready for launch, plus early access before we open sign-ups to everyone. If you applied for a teacher badge, we'll also email you the next steps for document review and your interview.

Padhai.pk is built for Pakistani students and teachers — priced in rupees, verified by CNIC — but our waitlist is open to anyone, anywhere, including Pakistanis abroad and teachers who want to reach students back home.

faqs.q: What if my subject's badge seats are already full?
faqs.a: You're automatically added to our general teacher waitlist, and we'll email you the moment a seat opens up or a new round starts. You're also welcome to apply again under a different subject.

faqs.q: Is Padhai.pk legit, or could I get scammed like on Facebook/WhatsApp tutoring groups?
faqs.a: Padhai.pk is a registered business under FBR and SECP compliance — not an anonymous page or a personal WhatsApp number, but a legally accountable company. On top of that, any payment you make is held by the platform and only released once your session is complete and you're satisfied, so you're never sending money to a stranger and just hoping for the best.

faqs.q: How do I know a teacher is actually qualified and not just a random profile?
faqs.a: You get to choose. Teachers can apply to become verified, which means their CNIC and qualification documents are reviewed before they get a verified badge. Not every teacher chooses to verify — it's optional — so as a student you can see who's verified and who isn't, and decide for yourself based on their profile, ratings, and reviews.

faqs.q: If I pay before the class, how do I know I won't lose my money?
faqs.a: Your payment doesn't go to the teacher right away — it's held securely by the platform as soon as you pay, and only released to the teacher after your session is completed successfully. This protects you because your money isn't released on trust alone, and it protects the teacher too, since payment is already secured and waiting once they've delivered the session.

faqs.q: What if the teacher doesn't show up, or the session isn't what was promised?
faqs.a: You have up to 6 hours after the session to file a dispute if the teacher didn't show up or didn't deliver what was promised. Payment isn't automatically released against your wishes during that window. The teacher also gets a chance to explain their side before anything is decided, so the process is fair to both sides.

faqs.q: Is there a free demo class, and is it actually free?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's completely optional. A student can request a demo class from a teacher, and both sides mutually agree on it — the platform just provides the tools to make that demo session happen. There's no hidden charge, and no pressure to take one if you'd rather just book a session directly.

faqs.q: As a teacher, do I have to pay just to send proposals to students?
faqs.a: No — every teacher gets free proposals to send to students at no cost. Proposal bundles are only for teachers who want an edge over others and want to send more proposals than their free allowance to reach more students faster. It's an optional way to grow, not something you're required to pay for just to participate.

faqs.q: As a teacher, will I actually get paid, and how long will it take?
faqs.a: As soon as your session is completed and no dispute is raised, your payment is released to you instantly. There's no waiting for a batch cycle or chasing the platform for your earnings — completion plus no dispute means the money is yours right away.

faqs.q: Does the app work with JazzCash/EasyPaisa, or do I need a bank card?
faqs.a: The platform works with any local wallet, bank transfers, and cards — so whether you use JazzCash, EasyPaisa, a bank account, or a debit/credit card, you're covered. You're not locked into one payment method.

faqs.q: What happens to my personal documents (CNIC, degree) if I apply for verification?
faqs.a: Since verification is optional and teacher-initiated, your documents are only submitted if and when you choose to apply for the verified badge. They're reviewed solely to confirm your identity and qualifications match your profile, giving students confidence in your credentials — it's a tool to help you get chosen, not a requirement to be on the platform at all.

faqs.q: What if a teacher and student just exchange numbers and skip the app after the demo?
faqs.a: Everything valuable about being on Padhai.pk lives only inside it. Teachers keep their review history, proposal visibility, and instant, secured payment on every completed session — all of which disappear off-platform. Students keep escrow protection, a 6-hour dispute window, and a documented session history. Staying isn't enforced by threats; it's simply where the protection, reputation, and reliable payment actually exist.
